speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling in your palms. To understand the underlying cause, could you tell me if this rash appears on the backs of your hands as well, and whether it worsens at night or after eating?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda. Based on your history of a pruritic rash on the upper body and face, combined with sensory changes in the palms and your occupation with livestock (potential viral hepatitis risk), this presentation is highly suggestive of PCT. Did you notice any blistering or scarring on the sun-exposed areas of your skin, or do you have a family history of similar skin issues?
